svg.desc: Tweet-sized quality snapshot for Fernly, a plant-care app. Headline: missed reminders kill plants, dead plants kill retention. Reminder delivery and household sync are Unknown — no telemetry, no oracle. Schedule math is proven by a property suite. First move: build the delivery ledger so the number-one churn driver stops being invisible.

svg.text: FERNLY · QUALITY STRATEGY · TRUST REPAIR → GREENHOUSE RELAUNCH
The strategy's honest read, before the September paid relaunch:

g.text: reminder delivery — zero telemetry; the #1 churn driver is invisible
household sync — two-device convergence never tested, not once
photo backups — restore never practiced; one bad migration from live
schedule math — property-tested, 11 regressions caught since January

svg.text: First move — Phase 0: build the reminder-delivery ledger.
Nothing gets called fixed until we can see.
